resource_plan.resource_basis: Frozen plan: 12 selected source states multiplied by 5 paired repetitions and 2 branch arms equals 120 environment branch runs; no adaptive replacement or additional model-planning calls are budgeted.

verification_plan.primary_endpoint: For each selected state, the paired difference between candidate and frozen comparator arms in verifier-recorded registered task progress, with task completion as the highest-priority progress event and invalid/nonexecuted repetition as a prespecified secondary diagnostic.
verification_plan.refutation_criterion: Refute the portfolio hypothesis if fewer than eight states achieve at least three candidate-arm paired progress wins, or if aggregate paired wins do not exceed aggregate paired losses across the 60 repetitions.
verification_plan.stop_condition: Execute exactly the frozen 120 branch runs unless an arm reaches its registered episode terminal condition; do not add, replace, or reallocate states based on observed outcomes. After all scheduled runs or registered terminal events are recorded, stop and seal the F0/F1 manifest.
verification_plan.support_criterion: Support the hypothesis only if at least eight of 12 states show candidate-arm registered task progress in at least three of five paired repetitions and aggregate paired wins exceed paired losses, with no increase in aggregate invalid or nonexecuted repeated actions.
